title: Where to Get Lily Allen 2026 ‘West End Girl’ North America Tour Tickets Before They’re Gone for Good
summary: The British singer's tour tickets are selling fast due to the hype of her new album.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

At long last, Lily Allen is back, and this time, she’s going on a North American tour.

It took almost seven years, but the English singer-songwriter made her return to music in a big way with her 2025 release of West End Girl via BMG, a scathing full-length triumph that serves as an autobiographical account of her marriage’s breakdown, particularly her relationship with actor David Harbour, best known for his work in the popular series Stranger Things .

The last time Allen dropped an album was 2018 with No Shame featuring “Family Man,” “Come On Then” and “Apples.”

View this post on Instagram

The album deals with topics like heartbreak, infidelity, open relationship struggles and the emotional fallout of her marriage to Harbour in late 2024/early 2025 after four years of marriage, following months of speculation sparked by Allen, who was seen publicly without her wedding ring numerous times.

The accompanying tour in support of the new album will see the “Dallas Major” singer perform her brand-new album in its entirety and in the order the songs appear on the record. Buzz for the tour has been major, likely because of the revealing nature of this album, giving fans and followers a peek into the messy fallout between Allen and Harbor. It’s a raw and real look into the struggles of marriage and womanhood.

Allen’s North American tour will begin on April 3 in Chicago at The Auditorium and conclude shortly on April 23 in San Francisco at The Masonic, with stops also made in Toronto. The North American leg is short, meaning competition for tickets is high. If you’ve been dying to see Allen on tour, but you’re not looking to spend a fortune on tickets, you’re in the right place.

Below, we’ve shared where you can snag affordable tickets from a slew of sites. We’ve also included promo codes from yours truly that’ll make those tickets even more affordable. Tickets are selling fast , with some venues already being sold out, so you’ll want to jump on the opportunity before they’re gone. Keep reading to find out more.

Where To Get Tickets To Lily Allen’s 2026 West End Girl North America Tour

AFFORDABLE OPTIONS

Ticketmaster

find tickets here

Ticketmaster offers a Fan Guarantee, which allows for cancellations, refunds or exchanges within 24 hours of booking, subject to certain exclusions.

Ticketmaster has a slew of good seating options left for Allen’s tour with standard tickets at some venues starting at as low as $103 in places like Chicago .

The ticketing site also recently announced that they’re barring fans and brokers from operating multiple accounts on its platform. They also plan to shut down its long-criticized TradeDesk ticket uploading application and start requiring ticket brokers to hand over their Social Security numbers in order to sell tickets on Ticketmaster’s resale platform, further making sure your tickets are secure.

LOTS OF SEATING LEFT

StubHub

If your event is canceled and not rescheduled, you will receive a credit worth 120% of the amount you paid for the impacted event, or the option of a cash refund.

StubHub features a bunch of seating options left, even at hard to get venues like Radio City and Kings Theater in New York which have sold out at places like Ticketmaster. Tickets on StubHub are rather pricy though, so keep that in mind as you browse. You can shop for all dates and arenas with ease thanks to the ticketing service’s FanProtect Guarantee. This initiative protects fan’s purchases by ensuring valid tickets or your money back.

EARN REWARDS

Vivid Seats

You can grab seating options through Vivid Seats now.

Pricing is also pretty competitive on the site, however, Vivid Seats has a bunch of seating options to pick from. The ticketing service offers a 100% Buyer Guarantee that vows your transaction will be secure, that your tickets will be delivered before your event and that those tickets will be valid and authentic.

To help you combat that competitive pricing, you can use promo code BB30 to snag $30 off of your purchase. Our favorite feature of the site is that it shows you the lowest ticket pricing for each venue on the landing page without having to click into the venue so you can compare in one place.

PROMO CODES

SeatGeek

SeatGeek offers you venue options based on your location, giving you the closest venue to you.

With our help, you can grab Allen’s tour tickets with ease, at an affordable price. Seat Geek has a good amount of seats left, with some venues pricing starting at just $94 , a steal when you think about how competitive ticketing prices are for her show.

Right now, you can use promo code BILLBOARD10 at checkout to receive $10 off at checkout. We’ve seen tickets at some venues for as low as $69. The ticketing service features a Buyer Guarantee that ensures smooth ticket purchases every time.

PROMO CODE

Ticket Network

More savings can never be bad.

You can also get tickets to Allen’s tour through TicketNetwork which seems to have some of the best pricing we’ve seen. With the code BILLBOARD300 you can save $300 off orders of $1,000, and BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off orders of $500. This makes ticketing even more affordable on the site.

If you don’t have the funds to buy your tickets just yet, you can also buy the tickets on the website now and pay later with help from Affirm. Plus, the website includes all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll be paying upfront (fees included).

MORE SEATING OPTIONS

Gametime

Gametime features a slew of seating options for a range of prices.

Some venues have tickets starting at $96, while others are up for $353 depending on the demand for the venue. Gametime guarantees the lowest prices, event cancellation protection, job loss assurance and on-time ticket delivery for a smooth ticket buying experience every time, no matter the occasion.
